newsitem.title: SPAIN: First day of trade for Spain's new Ibex-35 future.
newsitem.headline: First day of trade for Spain's new Ibex-35 future.

text.p: Spain's new Ibex-35 futures contract, which will replace the old on January 20, started trade on Friday.
Last October, equity derivatives exchange Meff said the new contract would raise the nominal value of the futures contract to 4.3 million pesetas from the current 430,000.
By increasing the multiple value by 10 times, an investor can now purchase the same nominal value with one contract as he had in the past with 10.
In the first nine months of the year, the exchange said the volume represented by operations of less than 10 contracts was just 1.26 percent of the total.
